title: HEADLAMP VAC HOSE ROUTING & RELAY MOUNTING
summary: Front-end routing of the headlamp vacuum hoses (color-striped white, red, yellow, green) from the two headlamp vacuum relay valves to the headlamp actuators, plus the headlamp washer hose. The two relay valves are screwed to a bracket, and the bracket is screwed up to the underside of the front reinforcement (View A). Hoses are bundled with plastic straps and held to the generator & front lamp harness with a clip.

parts.name: CLIP
parts.name_expanded: Clip – hoses to generator & fwd lamp harness

fastening.note: View A: each relay valve [3] mounting flange is screwed up into bracket [4] with screws [5] (two holes per valve shown).
View A: bracket [4] goes up against the reinforcement and is held with screws [6] driven up through the bracket into the reinforcement (several holes shown, single callout).
Straps [1] tie the vacuum and washer hoses together and to the harness at about five places along the route to the headlamp actuators and horns area.
Clip [2] holds the vacuum hose bundle to the generator & front lamp harness near the wiper-motor end.

notes_internal: Torque legend has only triangle 1 filled; digit legible as 1. Triangles 2-5 empty; stamp 'K234'.
Vacuum hoses, actuator asm., horns and washer hose are labeled but have no callouts on this sheet.
Colored vacuum hoses push onto the relay valve [3] nipples (View A); no clamps shown.
